pick.headline: Civil war erupts in South Yemen
pick.summary: On 13 January 1986 a shoot-out at a Politburo meeting in Aden began a short, bloody civil war within South Yemen's ruling Marxist party.
pick.significance: Thousands were killed in less than two weeks, and Soviet citizens had to be evacuated. The conflict weakened Moscow's only Marxist client state in the Arab world.

alternates.headline: Soviet troops storm the Vilnius TV tower
alternates.summary: Early on 13 January 1991 Soviet troops and tanks stormed the television tower in Vilnius, killing fourteen civilians.
alternates.significance: The 'Bloody Sunday' crackdown hardened Baltic resolve and Western opposition to Moscow's use of force. It discredited Gorbachev's claimed ignorance of the operation.
